youth.direction: A restless, quick-thinking young adult; energetic and questioning. Distinct original synthetic voice.

philosopher.direction: An older adult speaking patiently, with gentle authority and no hurry. Distinct original synthetic voice.

segments.speaker: youth
segments.text: You keep telling people there's another way through this town. Look at this map. Every road into the old quarter ends at a locked gate.

segments.speaker: philosopher
segments.text: I believe you about the gates. May I ask who drew the map?

segments.speaker: youth
segments.text: The council. It's supposed to show every route.

segments.speaker: philosopher
segments.text: Does it show the stairs behind the bakery?

segments.speaker: youth
segments.text: No. Those are too narrow for a cart.

segments.speaker: philosopher
segments.text: Exactly. This map was made for delivery carts. You came here on foot.

segments.speaker: youth
segments.text: So all the roads are open after all?

segments.speaker: philosopher
segments.text: No. A locked gate is still a locked gate. But a map can be accurate and still leave something important out.

segments.speaker: youth
segments.text: Then how do I know which map to trust?

segments.speaker: philosopher
segments.text: Ask what question it was made to answer. Then go outside and check the ground. If neither map helps, draw what you've learned.

segments.speaker: youth
segments.text: You don't make the journey sound easier.

segments.speaker: philosopher
segments.text: Maybe it isn't. But at least now you're looking for a path, instead of arguing with the paper.
